cost_models.fixed_10bps_rt: 10 bp round trip; half at entry and half at exit
cost_models.square_root_impact: 1 bp round-trip floor + sigma20_daily_bps * sqrt(notional/ADV20); half charged each side

exposure_interpretation.market_beta_proxy: gross SPY exposure fraction by construction
exposure_interpretation.sector_exposure: broad-market SPY only; historical sector decomposition intentionally not inferred

warnings: Early Sequence and Full Sequence historical portfolio tests are post-discovery diagnostics, not independent OOS evidence.
The square-root impact model is a stress envelope, not a calibrated broker fill model.
SPY-only V1 cannot estimate true stock-level sector concentration or stock-specific capacity.
Portfolio-policy comparisons are not a parameter search and do not select a production winner.
